ifDeleted.summary: s01b is where Kristina first uses AI on stage: she builds the Slack-to-Jira bot in Cursor with Brendan, and that is the main home of guardrail 2. It also plants the setup that gets Brendan fired. He tracks his work in Linear and Kristina promises to copy it into Jira, which s19_l20 pays off. Cutting the scene leaves s11c's solo build and the s19 layoff reveal without their setup, and repairing that would mean rebuilding the demo somewhere else.
